name: Fat-soluble accumulation
aliases: Fat-soluble accumulation, lipophilic compound accumulation, bioaccumulation in fatty tissue, fat storage of toxins
what_is: Bioaccumulation happens when a substance enters the body faster than it leaves. Persistent, fat-soluble contaminants such as dioxins and dioxin-like PCBs can build up in body fat for years. That is not true of every fat-soluble compound.
why_botia: BOTIA raises this only when an official assessment shows that a specific compound persists and builds up. More body fat alone does not prove greater risk. Nor can BOTIA assume concentrated release during menopause, pregnancy, breastfeeding or weight loss.
can_1: Provide contextual information on how fat-soluble compounds behave in the female body.
can_2: Connect this knowledge to specific ingredients flagged on the label when applicable.
cannot_1: Measure the actual burden of fat-soluble compounds in a specific person from the label.
cannot_2: Predict when or at what concentration accumulated compounds may release.
